subject: Day 17: bilingual exposure window; spurt resolving
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 17. Spurt should be resolving today or tomorrow. Feed cadence returns to typical. If a second-language parent is planning bilingual or trilingual exposure, this is when the consistent input pattern needs to be in place. Phoneme discrimination begins narrowing around 6 months; the establishment of the pattern matters more than volume right now.

Action items
- Establish the one-parent-one-language pattern if raising bilingual. Each language gets one consistent speaker from now through preschool. Bilingualism overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bilingualism
- If 1-month visit is not confirmed, confirm today. Target day 28-35. AAP Bright Futures periodicity: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Start researching daycare or nanny options if returning to work at 12-16 weeks. Top-tier Bay Area daycares have 6-18 month waitlists; nanny searches take 4-8 weeks. Care.com home page: https://www.care.com/
- Reorder maternal postpartum essentials only if still needed; lochia should be mostly stopped.
- Continue feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Spurt resolving; feeds returning to 2-3 hour cycle (breastfeeding) or 3-4 hour cycle (formula). Mother's lochia minimal or stopped.
- [low concern] Increased eye contact during feeds.
- [monitor] Persistent low mood, intrusive thoughts, or anxiety in Anoushka. Postpartum Support International: https://www.postpartum.net/
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting (pyloric stenosis presents weeks 3-6). Fewer than six wet diapers per day. Persistent maternal pelvic pain or new bleeding.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Conversational turns during awake-alert windows. When Avi makes any vocalization (coo, eh, grunt), respond as if he spoke a sentence, pause, then respond to his next sound. Turn-taking is the foundational language-learning pattern. Romeo et al., Psych Science 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/

Upcoming
- Day 17-21: growth spurt finishing.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak PURPLE crying curve at about 6 weeks.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.

Further reading
- Bilingualism overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bilingualism
- Care.com home page: https://www.care.com/
- Cribsheet by Emily Oster: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/562146/cribsheet-by-emily-oster/
- Romeo et al., Psych Science 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/
